summary: @or-sdk/sku-builder ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`, which auto-executes on `npm install`. setup.mjs is written with hex-mangled identifiers and per-function string dictionaries (an obfuscator.io style) that mismatches the rest of the package's clean TypeScript sources. At install time it downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line, string-array + rotator obfuscated blob (`function WV8StW(...) {...MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())...}`, hex identifiers `_0x...`) that is not referenced from `dist/` or `src/`, is not documented anywhere in the package, and has no relationship to the advertised REST SDK functionality. Invoking the payload through a freshly downloaded alternate JS runtime bypasses tooling that inspects Node execution, and executing an undocumented obfuscated blob at preinstall time is a supply-chain dropper against every machine that runs `npm install` of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
